leadText: Turning the Tera Tide (Japanese: ) is a 1-minute short to celebrate Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024, and a sequel to Bubble Beam Berry Blast. It was uploaded to the official American and European YouTube channels on July 9, 2024, and on the Japanese channel on July 14, 2024, on the Asian channels on July 20, 2024.
plainText:
Turning the Tera Tide (Japanese: ) is a 1-minute short to celebrate Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024, and a sequel to Bubble Beam Berry Blast. It was uploaded to the official American and European YouTube channels on July 9, 2024, and on the Japanese channel on July 14, 2024, on the Asian channels on July 20, 2024.

==Blurb==
 Our glistening hero quartet lands in hot water in Pokémon: Turning the Tera Tide! 👊🌊 

Watch Piplup, Greninja, Quaxly, and...Palafin ❓🤨 ...as they encounter a Dondozo with a mucky attitude! 

==Plot==
After collecting some Sitrus Berries , , , , and walking on the edge of a river. Making sure that no one is looking, Palafin quickly changes into its . The others are surprised to see where Palafin in the water. Suddenly, the ground starts shaking and a stallized leaps out of the water, while roaring loudly. Greninja, Quaxly, and Piplup use , , and , respectively, but this does not faze Dondozo. Palafin also uses Water Gun, but when Quaxly turns to look at it, Palafin has disappeared. Piplup is annoyed at Palafin running away, but Hero Form Palafin taps it on the shoulder and launches a at Dondozo. Together, the four Pokémon use their attacks again, and as Palafin stomps on Dondozo, its Terastallization is finally broken. As Dondozo is confused to where it is, Quaxly feeds it a Sitrus Berry. Piplup notices Hero Form Palafin has disappeared once again to its annoyance, while Zero Form Palafin splashes around in the water.
